---
title: stat-identity
subtitle: "Identity statistic: returns data and mapping unchanged."
category: Stats
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Useful as an explicit marker; most geoms default to this statistic.

## Usage

```typst
stat-identity()
```



## Returns

Statistic object with `name: "identity"`, consumed by geom layers.

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/stat-identity-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2),
  (x: 2, y: 4),
  (x: 3, y: 3),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt, stat: "identity"),),
)
```

[`stat-count`](stat-count.qmd), [`stat-bin`](stat-bin.qmd), [`stat-smooth`](stat-smooth.qmd).
